notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded Unpublish Interaction Class implementation to the exact official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador declaration exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies the signature, declared exception set, adapter symbol, and real Catch2 selectors. The baseline declaration case verifies lifecycle/FOM boundaries; the focused filesystem-report case verifies that an invalid class appends nothing and an accepted unpublication appends one type-27 InteractionClassHandle successful-void record. Advisory delivery, MOM interaction delivery, timestamped interaction, save/restore, DDM, remote transport, packaging, catalog evidence, validation, and conformance remain outside this slice.
